A Little Closer to You

Across the Miles, to You.

Dear Rajesh,

You’re the person I turn to when I feel lost. You help me figure out what to do next, you teach me new things, and you remind me to keep going after my dreams. Even on busy days, I know you think of me. 🤍

I know I’ve told you I’d come and then changed my mind. I’ve even told you to find someone else. I can see why it’s hard to trust my words after hearing both things from me. You’ve been waiting to see me, and I’m sorry I’ve made that wait harder.

I’ve made up my mind about what I want. I want to come to India to see you, and I want to marry you. ❤️ I’m still figuring out when I can travel. I’ll keep you in the loop as I work out the details, and when I have a date I can commit to, I’ll tell you.

Rajesh, I’m really excited about sharing my life with you. I know the distance makes things hard sometimes, but I’m ready to put in the effort and do my part to make this work. I’d love to hear what’s on your mind, too.

We’ve been friends for so long, I never thought the day would come when I’d actually tell you how I feel.

I hope this little surprise made you smile. I wish I could’ve been sitting next to you when you opened it, just to see the look on your face. Until I can be there, this is my little way of feeling closer to you. ❤️

Love,
Janu

I love you, Rajesh.

I’m looking forward to the day I get to say that with you right in front of me.

Some things are worth waiting for. I think we’re one of them.
